description: The secret files of the on-prem deployment: names, readers, rotation. References only; a value in this repository fails infra:check. Create each as a file named <name> under MACHVON_SECRETS_DIR (owner root, mode 0400).

secrets.name: database_url_owner
secrets.purpose: URL of the owner role, used by the migration job only
secrets.generate: a postgres connection URL for role machvon_owner (the password of db_owner_password), host db, port 5432, database machvon; the role password is a hex string from openssl rand -hex 32 (URL safe, no quotes)

secrets.name: database_url_app
secrets.generate: a postgres connection URL for role machvon_app, host db, port 5432, database machvon; the role password is a hex string from openssl rand -hex 32 (URL safe, no quotes)

secrets.name: database_url_control
secrets.generate: a postgres connection URL for role machvon_control, host db, port 5432, database machvon; the role password is a hex string from openssl rand -hex 32 (URL safe, no quotes)

secrets.name: database_url_outbox_relay
secrets.generate: a postgres connection URL for role machvon_outbox_relay, host db, port 5432, database machvon; the role password is a hex string from openssl rand -hex 32 (URL safe, no quotes)

secrets.name: outbox_signing_key
secrets.purpose: Signs the worker context of outbox deliveries (base64, at least 32 bytes)

secrets.name: tenant_token_signing_key
secrets.purpose: EC P-256 private key (PEM) that signs tenant access tokens

secrets.name: field_encryption_keys
secrets.purpose: Master keys of the personal data: id:base64 pairs of 32 bytes

secrets.name: license_signing_key
secrets.purpose: Ed25519 private key (PKCS8 PEM) that signs licenses

secrets.name: keycloak_db_password
secrets.purpose: Password of the keycloak database role

secrets.name: keycloak_admin_password
secrets.purpose: Password of the first Keycloak administrator (replace by named administrators with WebAuthn, then disable it)

secrets.name: ldap_bind_credential
secrets.purpose: Password of the directory service account used for federation

secrets.name: tls_cert
secrets.purpose: Certificate chain of PUBLIC_HOST (PEM), from the customer certificate authority
secrets.generate: issued by the customer certificate authority

secrets.name: pgbackrest_cipher_pass
secrets.purpose: Pass phrase of the client-side encryption of the backups (AES-256); losing it makes every backup unreadable: escrow it offline

secrets.name: backup_s3_access_key
secrets.purpose: Access key of the backup bucket (write and read, no delete of locked versions)
secrets.generate: issued by the object store administrator

secrets.name: backup_s3_secret_key
secrets.purpose: Secret key of the backup bucket
secrets.generate: issued by the object store administrator
